description: Body of the POST {bookings} request, which creates a booking from a quote.

quote_id.description: ID of an unexpired quote returned by quotes, not yet booked.

consumer_booking_id.description: Identifier of the booking in the consumer's system. Unique per consumer.

rider.description: The rider. Every field in required_rider_fields of booking_information.json MUST be provided.

id.description: Stable, opaque identifier of the rider in the consumer's system. MUST NOT carry personal data.

phone_number.description: Phone number the driver can call to reach the rider.

pickup_instructions.description: Instructions for the driver at pickup.
